exposure: duration of second stage of labor
cohort: The study included 72,593 mothers with singleton vaginal deliveries at ≥37 weeks of gestation in cephalic presentation from the Stockholm-Gotland region in Sweden, 2008-2012.
finding: Risks of maternal complications in the postpartum period increase with the duration of the second stage of labor, even after adjusting for maternal, pregnancy, and delivery characteristics.
